## Problem and change

Describe the issue, implemented correction, and intentionally unchanged behavior.

## Evidence

Record the exact commands and outcomes, including negative/regression cases.
Distinguish source, package, container, consumer and live-provider evidence.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Code, comments and documentation are in English (Unicode fixtures excepted).
- [ ] Authority, exact bindings, receipt replay and budgets are preserved.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation are updated.
- [ ] New material has reviewed provenance and compatible licensing/notices.
- [ ] No credentials, private source, raw receipts or consumer deployment records are included.

Do not report vulnerabilities in this PR. Follow the private Security Policy.
Publication or deployment requires its own explicit authorization and evidence.
